plan.notes: The catalog does not prescribe a semester-by-semester sequence for the AA/AS; the four semesters below follow a standard full-time pacing. All core-area options are from the college's official Core Curriculum Selection List, 2026-2027 catalog. Additional Requirements: 18 SCH as recommended in the selected Transfer Advising Guide; nine of the 18 hours must be from the official AS course list, remaining nine any transfer course.
